title: Scheme finder
subtitle: A few quick questions, then the schemes you can get

ownsLand.title: Do you own farmland in your name?
ownsLand.hint: Your name is on the 7/12 extract.

landAcres.title: How much land do you farm?
landAcres.hint: Owned or on lease, in acres.

category.title: Which category are you in?
category.hint: Some schemes give more help to SC and ST farmers.

hasBankAccount.title: Do you have a bank account?
hasBankAccount.hint: Scheme money is paid straight into it.

hasAadhaar.title: Do you have an Aadhaar card?
hasAadhaar.hint: We never ask for the number.

isWoman.title: Are you a woman farmer?
isWoman.hint: Women farmers get a higher subsidy in some schemes.

irrigation.title: How do you water your crops?
irrigation.hint: Drip and sprinkler subsidies depend on this.

incomeTaxPayer.title: Do you pay income tax?
incomeTaxPayer.hint: Income tax payers can't get PM-KISAN.

note: Final approval is by the government office. Check the details on the official website.
emptyBody: We couldn't find schemes for these answers. Try changing them, or ask an expert.
noneEligibleBody: With these answers you don't qualify for these schemes right now. A Kisan Call Centre expert can suggest others.
escalateReason: Not sure about a scheme or a document? Kisan Call Centre can guide you for free.
voiceHint: Say your name, village, district, land, crop and bank.
voiceError: Couldn't catch that. Try again, or type below.
voiceDenied: The microphone is blocked. You can type instead.
pendingCount_one: Check the {{count}} field filled by voice to save
pendingCount_other: Check the {{count}} fields filled by voice to save
badAcres: Enter land as a number, like 2.5
savedBody: Nothing has been sent yet. Open the official website and use these details to apply.
privacyNote: These details stay on this screen only and are cleared when you leave.
shareBody: Shares only the scheme, your district, crop and land size range. Never your name, village or bank.
shareFailed: Could not share. Nothing was sent.
shareQueued: Will be shared when you are online
savedBodyShared: Your name, village and bank were not sent. Open the official website and use these details to apply.
privacyNoteShared: Name, village and bank stay on this screen only. Only the anonymous summary is shared.
